text: とおくの　カレと　ポケモンを　こうかん　できたの！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　こうかん　できたの！
structure.en: I was able to trade Pokémon!

patterns.name: 〜の (soft statement)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement, not a question, is a soft, often feminine way of telling someone news. こうかん できたの = 'I was able to trade, you know!'.
